context:
Goal: every cloud session can use the session mail store.
Problem (rule): you ruled 754 a, add session-mailbox to the cloud environment's GitHub repo list. No session can edit that list; it is your own act in claude.ai. This is also your word for attaching that repo.
Based on (read): the coordinator's reading of Anthropic's cloud setup docs, 14:58 CST: the cloud environment menu in a session's title bar, then Edit, then Repositories, "where offered (the Default environment has none)". Each new session must start with that environment selected. Triage has not read the docs page.
Departs from: main — the list holds the repos it holds today; this adds session-mailbox.
Meanwhile: if your environment is the Default one, the option may not exist; then the fallback is a per-session add_repo of session-mailbox, which is also your word under 754 a. Nothing else waits.
lastAnswer: note: sessions can just add it; note to always add it

options.gain: Every cloud session can use mail.
options.how: In claude.ai, open a cloud session, use the environment menu in the title bar, then Edit, then Repositories, and add session-mailbox. Then start new sessions with that environment selected.
options.label: Edit the cloud environment's repo list and add session-mailbox
options.lose: A few clicks; the Default environment may not offer the list.

options.gain: No environment edit; each session attaches the store itself.
options.label: My environment is the Default one: use the per-session add_repo fallback
options.lose: Every session attaches it again; it is your word each time unless you grant it once.

options.label: Later
options.lose: Mail stays unavailable to cloud sessions that cannot attach the store.

reply: Filed as ruling own-763-add-repo-self. Your words say nothing about push access, so an attach with push stays your word only.
short: Add session-mailbox to the cloud environment's repo list
title: Add the session-mailbox store to your cloud environment's GitHub repo list
why: Only you can edit the environment in claude.ai; no session can.
